Faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
Faq.subheading: Didn't find your answer? Write to us through the contact form.
Faq.howAnswer: You search for houses available in your country, compare up to three projects, check legal compliance through the Compliance Engine™, and then send one inquiry to your chosen producers instead of writing to each one separately.
Faq.costAnswer: Browsing offers, comparing, and sending inquiries are free. The only paid item is the optional plot analysis report for a specific project.
Faq.priceQuestion: Why is the price a range, not a single amount?
Faq.priceAnswer: The final price depends on the finishing standard, transport to your location, and the scope of assembly. The range shows the real span before you receive a binding offer from the producer.
Faq.complianceQuestion: What does the Compliance Engine™ check?
Faq.complianceAnswer: The construction, insulation, ventilation, and required documentation of a given house against the building regulations of the country it's going to — before you send an inquiry to the producer.
Faq.producersQuestion: How do you know the producers are vetted?
Faq.producersAnswer: Every producer on the platform goes through ModularHub verification, shown as a badge on their card, before their projects appear in search results.
Faq.timeQuestion: How long does it take to receive offers?
Faq.timeAnswer: Usually up to 48 hours after sending the inquiry — producers reply directly to the address given in the contact form.

energyClassDetail.A+: Very low heat loss — the highest energy-efficiency class for windows and doors.
energyClassDetail.A: Low heat loss — energy-efficient windows and doors.
energyClassDetail.B: Moderate heat loss — solid, standard tightness.
energyClassDetail.D: Basic tightness class, without enhanced insulation.
energyClassDetail.nieznana: The energy class of the windows and doors will be chosen together with the manufacturer, based on your needs and budget.

ventilationSummary.mechaniczna-nawiewno-wywiewna: This project has mechanical supply-and-exhaust ventilation.
ventilationSummary.rekuperacja: This project has ventilation with heat recovery.
ventilationSummary.brak: This project has no mechanical ventilation system.
ventilationSummary.inna: This project has a custom ventilation system.

ventilationDetail.grawitacyjna: Air exchanges through vents and pressure differences — worth opening windows too in summer.
ventilationDetail.mechaniczna-nawiewno-wywiewna: The system exchanges air automatically all year round, no need to open windows.
ventilationDetail.rekuperacja: Automatic air exchange with heat recovery — fresh air without losing energy.
ventilationDetail.brak: No mechanical ventilation system — air only exchanges through windows.
ventilationDetail.inna: A custom ventilation solution — details to confirm with the manufacturer.

heatSourceSummary.pompa-ciepla-powietrze-woda: The house is heated using an air-to-water heat pump.
heatSourceSummary.pompa-ciepla-grunt-woda: The house is heated using a ground-source (ground-to-water) heat pump.
heatSourceSummary.gazowe: The house is heated with gas.
heatSourceSummary.biomasa-pellet: The house is heated with biomass / pellet.
heatSourceSummary.inne: The house is heated using a different, custom solution.

heatSourceDetail.pompa-ciepla-powietrze-woda: A heat pump draws energy from outside air and transfers it to the heating system — works year-round, even at low temperatures.
heatSourceDetail.pompa-ciepla-grunt-woda: A heat pump draws energy from the ground via a collector or borehole and transfers it to the heating system — stable output regardless of weather.
heatSourceDetail.gazowe: Heat comes from burning gas in a boiler — a proven, widely available solution that requires a gas connection.
heatSourceDetail.elektryczne: Heat comes directly from electricity — simple to install, running cost depends on the electricity price.
heatSourceDetail.biomasa-pellet: Heat comes from burning biomass or wood pellets in a boiler — needs storage space for fuel and regular refilling.
heatSourceDetail.inne: A custom heat source — details to confirm with the manufacturer.

zakres_uslug.question: What do you expect from the manufacturer?

sam_dom.label: Just the house
sam_dom.consequence: You arrange transport, assembly and the foundation yourself or with another company.

dom_i_transport.label: House with transport
dom_i_transport.consequence: The manufacturer delivers the house; assembly and the foundation stay on your side.

dom_transport_montaz.label: House, transport and assembly
dom_transport_montaz.consequence: The manufacturer sets up the house on your plot; you arrange the foundation separately.

kompleksowo_z_fundamentem.label: Complete, including the foundation
kompleksowo_z_fundamentem.consequence: Least work on your side, usually a higher total price.

do_150k.label: Up to EUR 150k
do_150k.consequence: We'll match models and finishing standard to this amount.

150_do_250k.label: EUR 150k–250k
150_do_250k.consequence: A wider choice of models and higher finishing standard within reach.

250_do_400k.label: EUR 250k–400k
250_do_400k.consequence: Opens up larger houses and a fuller scope of manufacturer services.

powyzej_400k.label: Above EUR 400k
powyzej_400k.consequence: No limits on model, finishing standard or scope of services.

termin.question: When would you like to move in?

jak_najszybciej.label: As soon as possible
jak_najszybciej.consequence: The advisor will check which manufacturers have open production slots now.

do_6_miesiecy.label: Within 6 months
do_6_miesiecy.consequence: Enough time for an unhurried choice of manufacturer and plot preparation.

do_roku.label: Within a year
do_roku.consequence: A comfortable timeline, less pressure on decisions along the way.

elastyczny.label: Flexible, over a year
elastyczny.consequence: Timing isn't a priority when choosing the manufacturer.

gotowosc_dzialki.question: What stage is your plot at?

dzialka_i_pozwolenie.label: I have the plot and building permit
dzialka_i_pozwolenie.consequence: Manufacturers can plan production and assembly timing right away.

dzialka_bez_pozwolenia.label: I have the plot, waiting for the permit
dzialka_bez_pozwolenia.consequence: The advisor will account for permit time in the schedule.

szukam_dzialki.label: Still looking for a plot
szukam_dzialki.consequence: The advisor will help with what to look for when choosing a plot for this house.

potrzebuje_analizy.label: I need an analysis of whether it fits
potrzebuje_analizy.consequence: The advisor will suggest a plot analysis before we move forward.

ogrzewanie.question: What would you prefer to heat the house with?

pompa_ciepla.label: Heat pump
pompa_ciepla.consequence: Higher installation cost, lower bills later.

gaz.label: Gas
gaz.consequence: Lower installation cost, higher heating bills.

elektryczne.label: Electric
elektryczne.consequence: Simplest installation; running cost depends on your electricity tariff.

kominek_biomasa.label: Fireplace or biomass
kominek_biomasa.consequence: Needs space for fuel and a chimney; independence from other utilities.

standard_wykonczenia.question: What finishing standard should the house have?

surowy_zamkniety.label: Shell only, closed
surowy_zamkniety.consequence: You arrange the interior finishing yourself, a lower price from the manufacturer.

deweloperski.label: Developer finish
deweloperski.consequence: Installations ready, surface finishing stays on your side.

pod_klucz.label: Turnkey
pod_klucz.consequence: House ready to move into, the highest price from the manufacturer.

EnvelopeParameters.heading: Insulation of building parts
EnvelopeParameters.intro: Numbers given by the manufacturer for the walls, roof, floor and windows. The lower the U value, the better the house keeps heat in. The higher the Rc value, the better.

wall.label: External walls
wall.description: The whole wall from inside to outside, including the insulation.

roof.label: Roof
roof.description: The roof or the ceiling under the roof, including the insulation.

floor_ground.label: Floor on the ground
floor_ground.description: A floor that rests on the ground, with no space underneath.

floor_air.label: Floor over open air
floor_air.description: A floor raised above the ground, with air underneath.

window.label: Windows
window.description: The whole window with frame and glass (Uw).

glazing.label: Glazing
glazing.description: The glass only, without the frame (Ug). This is not the same as the whole window.

status.confirmedHelp: A platform administrator reviewed the document the manufacturer provided. This is not a certificate or a test.

explain.u: U is the heat transfer coefficient, in W/m²K. It shows how much heat escapes through one square metre of the building part. A lower number means better insulation.
explain.rc: Rc is thermal resistance, in m²K/W. It shows how strongly the building part holds heat back. A higher number means better insulation.
explain.notEqual: U and Rc are not the same thing. You cannot convert one to the other by simply dividing 1 by Rc, because U is calculated for the whole building part including the surfaces at the wall.
explain.ug: Ug is for the glass only. Uw is for the whole window with its frame, so it is usually higher than Ug.
explain.ud: Ud is the heat transfer coefficient of an external door. A lower number means better insulation.
explain.asOf: As of is the date the value comes from. Rules and products change, so older numbers may be out of date.
explain.declared: A manufacturer declaration is a number the manufacturer gave us. The platform has not checked it yet.
explain.confirmed: Confirmed by the platform means an administrator reviewed the document the manufacturer provided. This is not a certificate or a test.
explain.permanent: A permanent foundation means the house is fixed to the ground for good, for example on a foundation slab.
explain.temporary: A temporary foundation means the house stands without a lasting connection to the ground, for example on blocks, and can be moved.

EnvelopeParameters.areaNote: The floor area in the catalogue can differ from the area counted under local rules. The 50 m² limit in the rules is counted by each country's own definition.
EnvelopeParameters.disclaimer: The values come from the manufacturer and do not replace a designer's calculations. They are not an assessment against the rules of any country.
